executive_summary.verdict: Measurements are real and accurately transcribed in the inspected records. Dream-RSI optimized a restricted loss on a defective visual pipeline, and its selected architecture never received completed matched control confirmation. Authorized recovery fixed concrete defects and achieved partial control, but no SmolVLM comparable to B16 was delivered and the remaining failure mechanism is unresolved.

findings.title: Inherited world-model loss is not leakage-free causal future prediction

findings.minimal_correction: Retain inherited loss to preserve this study, but name it accurately. A causal-context change belongs in a separately registered experiment, not a retrospective edit.

unresolved_questions: How much of legacy0/10 is due to image corruption versus conditioning transfer/trainability/optimizer history? No isolated corrected-input, frozen, held-out control comparison answers this.
Does n0008 outperform a clean Smol baseline under the same corrected processing, training exposure, initialization and numerical loader?
What causes most remaining systematic action error: visual/instruction/state representation, learned query interface, action-head adaptation or other transfer differences?
Would a different training recipe or adequate pretraining improve control? Sample-count disparities establish different exposure, not that more steps is sufficient.
Does held-out physical arm MSE reliably predict task success across candidate families or precision modes? No calibration across independent candidates/seeds exists.
How representative are the first6 validation frames/task and repeated first development initial states of full task trajectories and independent success?
How much closed-loop difference comes from hardware/numerical variation? Same-checkpoint3090/5090 outcomes differ; cross-hardware causal attribution requires matching protocol.
Are future architecture improvements reliable on the reserved500-state cohort? Recovery has no final result.
What exact upstream training membership/corpus produced baseline LIBERO weights, and did it include local held-out demonstrations? Existing data does not establish novel generalization.
Historical RSI external model and dataset artifact immutability is not fully recorded; cached artifact identity was not independently reconstructed in this bounded audit.

sources.facts: Qwen3-VL-2B uses learned latent/action tokens, current observations, frozen world-state targets and joint flow/world losses. LIBERO-Spatial success is 96.2% over 50 episodes per task. Fine-tuning uses 30k updates at global batch 256 after 50k pretraining; VLM/predictor and action-head rates are 1e-5 and 1e-4. The project differs in exposure, corpus, trainability and numerical protocol. Its local B16 result is 95.0%; a 48-fold presentation-count ratio is not a per-task compute ratio.

sources.note: Official repository linked by the paper; project runs use the pinned LeRobot port, whose semantics must be examined separately.
Contiguous event numbering and the previous-event SHA256 chain were verified.
n0008 derives from root. Five module hashes appear in the manifest and confirmation plan; frozen base bytes remain unchanged.

limitations: Independent forensic source, raw log/CSV and checkpoint metadata audit. No GPU forward, training, rollout, benchmark, rental or protocol change occurred.
Existing processor, precision and connectivity measurements were examined against source and their compact records, not re-executed.
Hash chains and log agreement establish internal consistency and traceability, not an absolute proof against fabrication or malice.
The focused lineage was the GPU study, PIL restart, main campaign and later recovery. Every candidate proposal and all older archived studies were not exhaustively reviewed.
No credentials, key contents, environment secrets or unrelated personal files were accessed.
Runtime retention and billing were reviewed only through compact receipts; operational and spending reconstruction belongs to another independent auditor.
Report source claims were reviewed directly. Full render and presentation review belongs to other auditors.
Original S500 failure and small recovery cohorts do not establish intrinsic SmolVLM capacity limits.
Research is stopped and acceptance remains unmet. This audit does not resume investigation.
